historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission adopted the CEQA findings regarding the request to construct a nine-story, 84-foot-high building containing up to 110 dwelling units for low-income senior citizens.

The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use authorization to construct a nine-story, 84-foot-high building containing up to 110 dwelling units for low-income senior citizens and to reduce the number of required residential parking spaces.
